Bushwood Country ClubCaddyshackTee off at the buffet.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersBushwood club sandwichesTriple decker turkey and bacon sandwiches with lettuce, tomato and mayoHow to make it8 rashers of bacon12 slices of white bread300g roast turkey1/2 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes3 tbsp mayonnaiseGrill the bacon until crisp.Toast the bread.Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each.Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.Gopher hole dipHot spinach and cream cheese dip baked in a hollowed loaf, bread to dipHow to make it1 cob loaf250g spinach250g cream cheese150g sour cream50g parmesan1 garlic cloveHollow the cob and tear the inside into pieces.Wilt the spinach, squeeze and chop, then mix with the cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and crushed garlic.Fill the cob and bake at 180°C with the bread pieces around it.Caddy shack mini chilli cheese dogsThe caddies' lunch breakHow to make itAs written, serves 4Cocktail franks in soft mini rolls, smothered in a quick beef chilli, melted cheddar and diced onion, served in paper boats.Brown 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, then add 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.Simmer 16 cocktail franks for 5 minutes.Split 16 mini rolls, add a frank, spoon over chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar.Grill 2 minutes until the cheese melts and finish with diced onion.Crab-stuffed mushroomsSmails's yacht christening, before Al's boat arrives.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsJudge Smails's prime ribRoast beef rib with horseradish sour cream and baked potatoesHow to make it2kg beef rib roast2 tsp salt4 potatoes2 tbsp horseradish200g sour cream1 bunch chivesSeason the beef and leave in the fridge overnight.Roast at 220°C to start, then lower to 160°C until 52°C inside.Rest the beef. Bake the potatoes alongside.Mix the horseradish into the sour cream.Carve thick and serve with the potatoes, sour cream and chives.Al Czervik's garlic prawn surf and turfThe loud new money at the clubHow to make itAs written, serves 4Eye fillet seared and roasted pink, topped with garlic prawns cooked in butter, chilli and lemon, with shoestring fries and a rocket salad.Season 4 eye fillet steaks of 180g.Sear in a smoking pan 2 minutes a side, then roast at 200°C for 6 minutes to 54°C inside and rest 5 minutes.In the same pan melt 60g butter with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli, add 400g peeled green prawns and cook 2 minutes.Squeeze in lemon and add parsley.Spoon the prawns over the steaks.Serve with 800g oven-baked shoestring fries and rocket.SweetsCountry club sundaeVanilla ice cream with hot fudge, whipped cream, peanuts and a cherryHow to make it100g dark chocolate300ml thickened cream1 L vanilla ice cream50g peanuts4 maraschino cherriesMelt the chocolate with a little of the cream for hot fudge.Whip the remaining cream and chop the peanuts.Scoop ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with cream, peanuts and a cherry. Keep it well away from the pool.DrinksNineteenth hole peach iced tea lemonadePeach black iced tea mixed with fresh lemonade, served over iceHow to make it4 black tea bags2 peaches4 lemons80g caster sugar500ml boiling water400ml cold water1 bunch mintice, to serveSlice the peaches. Brew the tea bags in the boiling water with the peaches.Remove the bags and cool with the peaches in.Stir the juice of three lemons with the sugar and cold water.Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in half tea and half lemonade, and add a peach slice, mint sprig and lemon wheel.Club gin and tonic with limeJudge Smails's pour for christening the Flying Wasp.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
